title: Grateful Dead Live at Warfield Theater on 1980-10-09
lineage: Tascam DA-20mkII > Delta DiO 2448 > SoundForge 4.5 (48-44.1, highest accuracy with anti-alias filter) > CDWAV > MKW Audio Compression Tool v0.97b1 (no DAE)
source: 7" 2-track BBD reel @ 7.5 ips > PCM501ES @ 44.055 kHz; PCM501ES analog out > Fostex D5 @ 48 kHz > 3 DAT Generations

ai_review.summary: Partial sound‑board tape that’s occasionally muddy yet regarded as a valuable addition by the reviewer
ai_review.review: The recording is a partial soundboard source and suffers from some unclear sections, which the reviewer notes as a drawback. Despite those technical flaws, the listener calls it a “plus” and awards it five stars, indicating strong overall appreciation of the performance.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one review; reviewer rates it highly (5 ★) but mentions clarity problems, leading to a balanced rating around four stars.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Partial tape with occasional unclear/muddy sections; otherwise usable.
